learning_outcomes.text: Evidence knowledge and skills learned in all prior studies, presented in the development and public defense of a thesis in the field of electric power and electric equipment.

syllabus_topics: Compilation and presentation of information by literature sources researching, the theoretical topics concerning to the thesis
Choice and use of the present efficiency project and research methods to solve the thesis problem
Presentation of the results, analysis, conclusions and recommendations
Formatting, printing and binding of the thesis
Giving the thesis to the supervisor
Permit to thesis defence by chief of the department
Reviewing the thesis and defence of it
teaching_methods: Problem solving (working in university or other libraries, computer halls, laboratories, manufactures)
assessment_rules: The thesis is defended before an Examining Committee, which evaluates the quality of the development and the defense. The thesis rate given by the reviewer is also reported.
institution: University Of Ruse Angel Kanchev — Electrical Power Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS FEEA (datos antiguos; ver notas)
